answer: Tie each identity to unique storage: every account must hold a sealed 256 MB replica derived from its own key, and a random beacon asks for 8 chunk proofs per epoch within 2 seconds. A clone cannot mirror one disk, since sealing takes minutes, so n fakes need n times 256 MB and n sealing jobs. Missed proofs cost 5% of a 30 POA bond. Soft velvet claims or a lotus of shell accounts fail, and anyone can verify the proofs on-chain.
